statement: AWS plans to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across its global infrastructure in 2027-2028.
why: A named multi-year unit commitment from the largest cloud buyer is the clearest forward read on merchant-GPU demand.

impact.mechanism: Committed hyperscaler unit volume pulls through GPU, HBM, packaging and fabric orders across the 2027-2028 window.

evidence.excerpt: AWS plans to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across its global infrastructure in 2027-2028

confidence.basis: Primary joint announcement from the vendor's own newsroom naming the customer, products and window.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: NVIDIA Newsroom, TechCrunch
